answer.book: Single academic disputation (Disputatio philosophica, Bern 1699) defended by Abraham Spengler under Samuel Leemann: front matter with dedications to patrons and friends, the Theses philosophicae of Physica noetica in two numbered chapters, then the Corollaria defendentis in eight numbered sections, and closing verses.
